name: The Wizards Discount Manager for WooCommerce
author: The Wizards

sections.description:
Create and manage automatic offers from WooCommerce > Discount Manager.

Features:
* Percentage, one-time fixed amount, target unit price and buy/get discounts.
* All products, selected products/variations, or categories including descendants.
* Cart subtotal limits, per-line quantity limits, customer roles and date schedules.
* New customers only: a first-order offer, one use per customer account/email.
* Exclusive offers, priority ordering, sale-item exclusions and coupon coexistence controls.
* Automatic native coupons, with line caps and WooCommerce tax allocation.
* HPOS-compatible order metadata and Cart/Checkout Blocks coupon labels.
* AJAX product, variation, SKU and category selection using WooCommerce SelectWoo.
* Rule duplication plus versioned JSON backup/restore as inactive copies.
* Responsive, RTL-aware, translation-ready administration.
* No paid dependencies, remote assets or telemetry.

The plugin does not change catalog prices. No persistent coupon posts are created.
An order records the actual discount and a snapshot of the applied rule.
Existing orders remain unchanged when rules are edited, disabled or deleted.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate a supported WooCommerce version.
  2. Upload the-wizards-discount-manager-for-woocommerce.zip in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate The Wizards Discount Manager for WooCommerce.
  4. Open WooCommerce > Discount Manager > Add discount rule.
  5. Save a rule and add eligible products to the cart.

WooCommerce’s “Enable the use of coupon codes” setting must be enabled.
The plugin displays a notice and pauses rules if this setting is disabled.
No Composer, npm, build command or paid extension is required on your server.
sections.faq:
Does it require XStore or WPBakery?

No. It uses WooCommerce APIs and works independently of themes and page builders.
Custom cart templates and other pricing plugins still require store-specific checks.

Why automatic coupons instead of negative fees?

WooCommerce documents that add_fee() should not receive negative values.
Native coupons keep discounts in the normal line-item and tax calculation pipeline.

What does buy 2/get 1 mean?

The customer puts 3 units in one cart line and 1 receives the configured discount.
Six units produce two sets. Products are not added automatically and different
products, variations or cart lines are not combined into a set.

How are multiple rules combined?

The first eligible exclusive rule wins globally. Otherwise lower priority values
run first and each rule discounts the remaining eligible value. Ties use rule ID.

Can shoppers use normal coupons too?

By default normal coupons pause automatic offers. Enable “Allow this rule
alongside customer-entered coupons” for the individual rule to allow stacking.
Individual-use coupons always suppress automatic offers.

Can a welcome discount be used once by new customers?

Yes. Enable “New customers only — one use per customer” in Conditions.
Existing orders are checked by account and email. Guests qualify after entering
a valid billing email. Pending/on-hold orders reserve eligibility; processing,
completed and refunded orders block reuse. Unpaid failed/cancelled orders allow
retry. Different guest emails cannot reliably be identified as one person.
See docs/USER-GUIDE.md for payment retries, order statuses and limitations.

Which price basis is used?

Cart thresholds exclude tax, shipping and fees and are checked before discounts.
Currency discount/target amounts follow the WooCommerce product price setting.
WooCommerce handles the tax adjustment on the eligible lines.

Does it support multiple currencies?

This release targets a single store currency. Rules record their currency and
pause when it changes. Currency converters require an integration; do not assume
that a currency conversion plugin will automatically convert rule amounts.

Can I move a JSON backup to another site?

IDs and roles must exist on the destination site, and currency must match.
Imported rules are inactive. Review all selections because numeric IDs can refer
to different products/categories on another site. Imports do not map by SKU.

Can an automatic coupon be removed?

Automatic offers are recalculated from eligibility. The classic cart hides their
remove link. A Blocks remove control may still appear; an eligible automatic
offer will return when totals recalculate. Managers control offers through rules.

What happens on uninstall?

Rules are retained by default. To remove this plugin’s rule/temporary-lock tables and schema option on
the current site when uninstalling, define TWWDM_REMOVE_DATA_ON_UNINSTALL as true
in wp-config.php first. Existing order metadata and all products remain intact.
Network-wide deletion is intentionally not performed.
sections.changelog:
1.6.0

  • Added “New customers only — one use per customer” in Conditions.
  • Added account/email history checks, guest-email updates and checkout/payment
    validation for classic and Blocks checkout, using HPOS-compatible order APIs.
  • Added atomic short-lived customer locks to protect simultaneous submissions.
  • Added backward-compatible schema migration, rule-list badges and documentation.

1.5.0

  • Initial release under The Wizards Discount Manager for WooCommerce brand.
  • Replaced the original negative-fee proposal with automatic WooCommerce coupons.
  • Added role targeting, sale exclusions, coupon policy, category descendants,
    currency protection, order snapshots, duplication, and JSON backup/restore.
  • Added strict validation, protected mutations, SelectWoo scope switching,
    integer allocation and documented priority/exclusive behavior.
